name: Virtual Trailing Stop
summary: This EA implements a virtual trailing stop mechanism that monitors open positions and automatically modifies stop loss levels as price moves in favor, without relying on the broker's native trailing stop functionality. It operates as a trade management utility that does not open its own positions but instead manages existing ones by trailing their stop losses according to user-defined parameters.
summary_zh: 该EA实现了一个虚拟追踪止损机制，监控已有持仓并在价格有利移动时自动修改止损水平，而不依赖经纪商的原生追踪止损功能。它作为交易管理工具运行，不自行开仓，而是根据用户定义的参数对现有持仓进行追踪止损管理。
strategy_analysis: 该EA是一个纯工具型程序，不包含任何入场策略或信号生成逻辑。它的核心功能是在持仓盈利达到指定点数后，将止损移动到保本或盈利位置，并随着价格继续有利移动而持续跟进止损。出场条件完全取决于追踪止损的触发，即价格回撤超过设定的追踪距离时平仓。仓位管理方面，该EA不涉及开仓手数计算，仅管理已有持仓的止损水平。资金管理方面同样不涉及，因为该工具不执行任何开仓操作。用户可配置的参数通常包括追踪启动点数、追踪距离、步进大小等，以控制止损移动的精细程度。该EA的优势在于可以在不支持原生追踪止损的经纪商上实现类似功能，并且可以通过更灵活的参数设置实现比原生追踪止损更精细的控制。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is a pure utility tool that contains no entry strategy or signal generation logic. Its core function is to move the stop loss to breakeven or a profit level after the position reaches a specified profit threshold in points, and then continue trailing the stop as price moves further in favor. Exit conditions depend entirely on the trailing stop being triggered, meaning the position closes when price retraces beyond the configured trailing distance. Regarding position sizing, the EA does not handle lot size calculations since it only manages stop loss levels of existing positions. Money management is also not applicable as the tool does not execute any opening operations. User-configurable parameters typically include the profit threshold to activate trailing, the trailing distance in points, and the step size for stop loss adjustments, allowing fine-grained control over how aggressively the stop follows price. The utility's strength lies in enabling trailing stop functionality on brokers that do not support native trailing stops, and offering more flexible parameter tuning than broker-provided alternatives.

parameters.name: TrailingStart
parameters.description: 追踪止损启动点数，盈利达到此值后开始追踪
parameters.description_en: Trailing stop activation in points; starts after this profit

parameters.name: TrailingStop
parameters.description: 追踪止损距离点数，止损与当前价格保持的最小距离
parameters.description_en: Trailing stop distance in points from current price

parameters.name: TrailingStep
parameters.description: 追踪步进点数，止损每次移动的最小步长
parameters.description_en: Trailing step in points; minimum stop loss increment

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: 魔术号码，用于标识要管理的持仓，0表示管理所有持仓
parameters.description_en: EA magic number; 0 manages all positions

parameters.name: ApplyToAllSymbols
parameters.description: 是否应用于所有交易品种，false则仅当前图表品种
parameters.description_en: Apply to all symbols; false limits to current chart symbol

pros: 不依赖经纪商原生追踪止损功能，兼容性更好
参数灵活可调，可精细控制追踪启动点、距离和步进
作为独立工具运行，不干扰其他EA的开仓逻辑
可按魔术号和品种筛选要管理的持仓，灵活性好
虚拟止损不会在服务端可见，避免经纪商窥探交易策略
pros_en: Broker-independent implementation works on any MT5 broker regardless of native trailing stop support
Highly configurable parameters allow precise control over activation threshold, trailing distance, and step size
Runs as standalone utility without interfering with other EAs' entry logic
Flexible position filtering by magic number and symbol allows targeted management
Virtual stop is not visible on the server side, preventing brokers from seeing your exit strategy
cons: 依赖于客户端运行，如果终端断开连接则追踪止损失效
不提供入场信号或策略，需要配合其他EA或手动交易使用
参数设置不当可能导致止损过于紧密被正常波动扫掉
无法管理其他终端或移动端开仓的持仓
缺乏可视化界面显示当前追踪状态
cons_en: Client-side dependency means trailing stop stops working if the terminal disconnects or crashes
Provides no entry signals or strategy, requiring pairing with another EA or manual trading
Improper parameter settings can result in stops being too tight and getting stopped out by normal volatility
Cannot manage positions opened from other terminals or mobile devices
Lacks a visual dashboard to display current trailing status for monitored positions
improvements: 增加断线保护机制，在连接恢复后自动恢复追踪状态
添加可视化面板显示当前持仓的追踪止损状态和距离
增加基于ATR的动态追踪距离选项，适应市场波动性变化
improvements_en: Add connection recovery mechanism that automatically resumes trailing after terminal reconnection
Implement a visual dashboard showing current trailing stop status and distance for each position
Add ATR-based dynamic trailing distance option to adapt to changing market volatility

risk_points: 客户端依赖风险：终端断开时追踪止损完全失效，持仓将无保护
参数配置风险：追踪距离设置过小可能在市场噪音中被频繁触发止损
risk_points_en: Client dependency risk: trailing stop completely fails when terminal disconnects, leaving positions unprotected
Parameter misconfiguration risk: setting trailing distance too small may cause frequent stop-outs from market noise
